title: Customer Success Executive
description:
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients. Understand customer needs and provide timely solutions. Ensure smooth onboarding and adoption of products/services. Monitor customer engagement and identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer concerns efficiently. Gather customer feedback and share insights with relevant teams. Support customer retention and contribute to account growth. 
 BBA MBA B.Com 
 1 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Relationship Management, or SaaS Customer Support . Hands-on experience working with SaaS products is mandatory. Prior experience in an IT Product-Based Company preferred. Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management and retention strategies. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical customers. Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar platforms is a plus.
